label: context.reference
text:
Use the SharePoint Application through world_mcp_microsoft_sharepoint. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for SharePoint sites, files, lists, pages, search, and collaboration capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_microsoft_sharepoint.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_microsoft_sharepoint, label mcp.operation.request, operation microsoft_sharepoint.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use microsoft_sharepoint.read_resource, microsoft_sharepoint.get_prompt and microsoft_sharepoint.complete with catalog identifiers; use microsoft_sharepoint.status or microsoft_sharepoint.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
